title: 第一卷 第7章 武道大宗师第一卷 第8章 什么他回来了古籍
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: 林府格外热闹，王管家站在门前满面春风，不时与来人抱拳打招呼。
今日是林老爷大寿的日子，外加其至少先天武师的境界，镇子中有头有脸的人，几乎都来拜会。
况且，从上次之后，寒家再也没出现过。
这就说明，自家老爷真让寒家忌惮了！
“王管家，恭喜恭喜啊！”
“啊，哈哈哈！张老爷，同喜同喜！”
“别别别，这是折煞我也，我哪敢称一声老爷。”
“哈哈哈，谦虚了......”
王管家整张脸都快笑成了朵菊花，这么多年来，他从没像今天这么扬眉吐气过。
府中厢房。
“夫君，今日大寿，您真不用出去看看么？”
经过几日相处，杨芸已经与林寻熟络许多，毕竟日久生情。
林寻参照秘籍，认真指点杨芸，
“不用，臀再抬高点，芸儿今日的修炼务必落实，也能早日跨入武者行列。”
“是！都听夫君的。”杨芸小声回应一句后专心修炼。
她绝不会让夫君失望的，想到这里，脸色更是红润了几分。
初为人妇，虽食髓知味，但夫君的需求未免太大了些。
她每日都以不堪征伐、难以承欢求饶收场。
而夫君甚至有时，还会在白天......
林寻满意点头，按照这个进度再加上补药，杨芸很快就能成武者了。
经过这几日服用灵乳，他又有新的发现，那就是双修的时间越长，灵乳的效果越好。
所以，他每日恨不得除了修炼之外，都和杨芸探讨大道，只是这小姑娘难以承受罢了。
属实可惜。
当然，若是有双修秘术就更好了，还不会损耗自身精力。
林寻时不时念动口诀，身上的气息也越发缥缈，看来用不了多久这敛息术就能真正入门。
到时候，可去寻找坊市。
正午时分，王管家前来。
“主家，宾客皆至，就等您来开宴。”
“晓得了。”
林寻吐出一口气，站起身向外走去。
“芸儿，你就不用去了，好生歇息着。”他的声音轻飘飘传入杨芸耳中。
杨芸浑身一震，脆生生道：“是，多谢夫君！”
毕竟不管怎样，她一个黄花闺女，嫁给高龄老人，都不算是件光彩的事情，少不得背地里被人指点。
夫君不让她露面，是在心疼她。
片刻之后，林寻就来到院中。
“林老爷来了！”
“林老爷您身体这么硬朗，我看啊，起码还能再活百岁！”
content_en:
The Lin Mansion was particularly lively. Butler Wang stood in front of the door with a cheerful expression on his face, greeting visitors with cupped fists from time to time.
Today is Mr. Lin's birthday, and since he is at least an innate martial artist, almost all the prominent people in the town come to visit him.
Moreover, since the last time, the Han family has never appeared again.
This shows that my master is really afraid of the Han family!
"Steward Wang, congratulations!"
"Ah, hahaha! Mr. Zhang, we are all happy!"
"No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no."
"Hahaha, I'm so humble..."
Butler Wang's whole face turned into a chrysanthemum with laughter. In all these years, he had never been so proud as he was today.
The wing room in the mansion.
"Husband, it's your birthday today, don't you really need to go out and see me?"
After a few days of getting along, Yang Yun has become very familiar with Lin Xun, and they have finally fallen in love with each other over time.
Lin Xun referred to the secret book and gave Yang Yun serious guidance.
"No, if you raise your hips a little higher, Yun'er must implement her training today, and she can step into the ranks of warriors as soon as possible."
"Yes! Listen to your husband." Yang Yun responded in a low voice and concentrated on practicing.
She would never let her husband down. Thinking of this, her face turned even more rosy.
As a new wife, although she knows the taste of food, her husband's needs are too great.
Every day she ends up being unable to endure the conquest, unable to accept joy and beg for mercy.
And my husband sometimes even does it during the day...
Lin Xun nodded with satisfaction. According to this progress and the addition of tonics, Yang Yun will soon become a warrior.
After taking the spiritual milk for the past few days, he made a new discovery, that is, the longer the dual cultivation time, the better the effect of the spiritual milk.
Therefore, every day, in addition to practicing, he wanted to discuss the avenue with Yang Yun, but this little girl couldn't bear it.
It's a pity.
Of course, it would be better if there were dual cultivation secret techniques, which would not waste one's own energy.
Lin Xun recited the mantra from time to time, and the aura on his body became more and more misty. It seemed that it would not be long before he could really get started with this breathing technique.
When the time comes, you can go look for Fangshi.
At noon, Butler Wang came.
"Master's house, all the guests are here, waiting for you to have a banquet."
"Got it."
Lin Xun let out a breath, stood up and walked out.
"Yun'er, you don't need to go, just have a good rest." His voice floated into Yang Yun's ears.
Yang Yun was shocked and said sharply: "Yes, thank you husband!"
After all, no matter what, it is not a glorious thing for her, a young girl, to marry an old man, and she will inevitably be criticized behind her back.
Her husband didn't let her show up because he felt sorry for her.
After a while, Lin Xun came to the courtyard.
"Master Lin is here!"
"Mr. Lin, your body is so strong. I think you can at least live another hundred years!"
